metadata.title: PastBook Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Product bricks are deployed to the PastBook mobile apps (iOS App Store and Google Play: camera-roll import, on-device and cloud curation, instant preview, editor, checkout, calendars and posters), to the web applications on pastbook.com (the web book creator, the Facebook Photo Books flow, the customer account and order history, the help center and pricing pages in ten languages), to integrations (Meta Graph API and Facebook Login, Dropbox and Google Drive, payment providers for Visa, Mastercard, American Express and PayPal, print partner APIs and hot folders with carrier tracking, and the app stores, Trustpilot and attribution platforms), to print outputs (print-ready PDFs for books, calendars and posters, packing slips and partner job tickets) and to internal operations (support desk, production control tower, growth and campaign console, analytics and experimentation, privacy and deletion tooling). Printing is done by partner facilities on four continents; each deployed brick records the products that use it.

channels.description: The PastBook: 1-Click Photo Book app for iOS and Android with 1M+ downloads: camera-roll import by date, location, album or Yearbook mode, curation in under 60 seconds, free preview and highlight video, editor, checkout in seven currencies, and calendars and posters as additional products. Full-stack bricks ship in both app builds; the curation engine and commerce services run as backing services called by the apps.

The iOS build (App Store id 1524251801, featured in several countries in September 2022) with Sign in with Apple, PhotoKit library access, the AI curation launched in July 2021, highlight video sharing since July 2023, books, wall calendars and posters.

channels.description: The browser surfaces on pastbook.com in ten languages: the web book creator for computer, Dropbox and Google Drive photos, the Facebook Photo Books flow with one book per year 2009-2025, the customer account with order history and tracking, and the public website with pricing and shipping pages and the help.pastbook.com knowledge base.

channels.description: Connections to the platforms and partners PastBook depends on: the Meta Graph API and Facebook Login, the Dropbox and Google Drive APIs, payment providers for Visa, Mastercard, American Express and PayPal, print partner order APIs and hot folders with carrier label and tracking services, and the Apple App Store and Google Play consoles, Trustpilot and the mobile measurement partner. All external calls pass through the integration gateway.
